extraction_scope: worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from source sections, figures, and supplementary PDF captions; mechanism strength is bounded to observed assays and author interpretation.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PuroA, P1, W7, WW and reported PuroA-derived peptides where tested
mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM and CD/source discussion support membrane-associated injury or membrane-environment conformational effects, but the paper frames mechanism as multifactorial rather than a single direct pore model.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD spectra and SEM morphology indicate membrane-associated effects; they do not alone prove a single lethal mechanism for every analog.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PuroA-derived peptides tested in gel retardation and E. coli filamentation assays
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Gel retardation and filamentation assays support possible DNA/intracellular target involvement, with peptide-specific differences in binding thresholds and filamentation behavior.
mechanism_claims.limitations: DNA binding was in vitro and filamentation is an indicator of possible intracellular action, not definitive target identification.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PuroA, P1, W7, and WW against MRSA M173525 biofilm assays
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Table 4 and supplementary microscopy support inhibition of initial MRSA attachment and activity against preformed 6 h biofilms for selected peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm inhibition is a phenotype and is not promoted to a molecular mechanism.
